environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 in VPC vpc-0x7e9f2a with identical code. Service is exposed ONLY through a VPC Endpoint Service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f) with connection acceptance required (AcceptanceRequired=true). The endpoint service has an associated Network Load Balancer (NLB) with a single-target target group configured with connection draining and proxy protocol v2 disabled. The NLB has cross-zone load balancing disabled. The VPC endpoint interface in the consumer VPC (vpce-0xabc123) is configured with a VPC endpoint policy that restricts to a single IAM principal (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/PaymentServiceRole). The consumer's security group on the VPC endpoint ENI (sg-0x9d2e1f) allows only a single source IP (10.44.2.17/32) which is the payment orchestrator singleton. The NLB target group has a max connections limit via target group attribute (deregistration_delay.connection_termination.enabled=true) and the single EC2 target runs the Flask app with gunicorn configured as --workers 1 --threads 1 (single-threaded synchronous processing). Additionally, the VPC has no NAT gateway or internet gateway attached, and the subnet route table has only local routes.
